notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347578/671a8ee7e42f5e9c900911f993d752b275567dc9.gif
Hey Northerners!
Welcome for the first time. From now on we'll be sharing with you the progress on the game, how it looks behind the scenes, what worked and what didn't quite work. We will always be open to suggestions, so feel free to share your ideas in the comments. 

First of all, we are currently focusing on writing entire systems. And so, for starters, we are currently testing:

weather system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347578/b19356269829824e0dd9b6122e09c6924d46741c.gif

shooting system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347578/189a04f1c8c09d13b67c029116b7417e105e1ed9.gif

collecting and crafting system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347578/68c930868521f6ca1613d08d5d1db6c9f1f1165a.gif

building system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347578/001ab4a4e389efb8612577e1acb99f99b3927bc8.gif


freezing system (cold damage, expanding frost on the screen)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39347578/89723eeb8beda144878ca02d5e7842ee80cf3440.gif


Of course, there are more things happening, but the most important information we would like to share with you is that we plan to bring you a demo later this year. So yeah... we are getting down to further work. Stay tuned and stay safe in these crazy times!
